programs.title: A8 - Abenteuer Autobahn
programs.desc: For the third time we will have the opportunity to look at German expressways.This time, the creators of the program take us from the A2 motorway to the A8 motorway.The 505-kilometer route starts in Perl, passes through Karlsruhe, Stuttgart, Augsburg and Munich, reaching all the way to the border with Austria.This road is one of the most important East-West connections in Central Europe.We will be able to see the work of the police, truck drivers, highway maintenance services, and engineers whose task is to smooth traffic.

programs.title: Misfit Garage 3
programs.desc: Mechanics from the Fired Up workshop in Dallas, Texas, specialize in restoring old, classic cars and building unique hot rods to order.The team is celebrating its first year of operation.Thanks to the experience and prestige they have gained, the guys decide to take on truly ambitious projects.One of them is the restoration of a rare 1978 Chevrolet Blazer with two-wheel drive.Additionally, Thomas has the opportunity to purchase a highly sought-after 1963 Pontiac Grand Prix.

programs.title: Road absurdities 4
programs.desc: In the next series, Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysztof Ruszała continue their developing trips around Poland, during which they look for the causes of various absurd road solutions.Using a prototype siren with the mysterious symbol S201, they will go to places where officials lightly spent huge amounts of money on non-functional communication infrastructure facilities.A bicycle path with pedestrian crossings every few meters, a speed limit for only one lane, a "zebra" right behind the "parking" sign, poles at the entrances to the garage, a lamppost in the middle of the road - this is just the beginning of the list of topics that tireless hunters of road stupidity will face.
